The role collaborates with business analysts, data stewards, a team of data and API modelers, and enterprise domain development teams to define and model enterprise data and processes. The person in this position will adhere to enterprise standards and best practices and maintain a robust inventory of standards for data and API artifacts. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of data structures and API design.
cond_0184.responsibilities: Has knowledge of commonly used programming concepts, practices, and procedures common to Object Oriented or service based designs. Understands when, where, and why to use different programming languages used by their development team. Able to identify and correct programming inefficiencies. May consult with users to identify current operating procedures and clarify program objectives. Follows test plans and/or creates test plans appropriate for the scope of the programming changes. Capable of understanding and employing various data storage techniques and utilities (DB2, XML, JSON). Creates or updates all documentation effected by a change, including rerun or disaster recovery documentation and procedures. Resolves production problems and participates in the nightly call list for problem resolution. Regular and predictable attendance. Completes a mandatory training program as determined by [Company name masked]. Performs other duties as assigned. Follows department standards and procedures and recognizes when changes to these may be justified.
cond_0184.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Able to provide the following across multiple business domains: adhere to enterprise standards and best practices; maintain a robust inventory of standards for data and API artifacts.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent of education and experience.
3-5 Years of data/API modeling experience.
Analytical problem-solving skills.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Business acumen in the insurance vertical.
cond_0184.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0184.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.
